commands.name: skill:agent-message
commands.description: Message an agent's parent, siblings, or direct children through the daemon. Discover reachable agents with agent-observe-list, then send direct text without spoofing sender identity.

commands.name: skill:agent-observe
commands.description: Read-only roster and observation of an agent's parent, siblings, and direct children. Use to discover reachable agents and to inspect family status and bounded recent-message previews without mutating sessions.

commands.name: skill:attach-image
commands.description: Load an on-disk image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) into the model's context as a viewable attachment so the model can directly SEE it — for screenshots, diagrams, charts, photos, or scanned pages. Use this when you need to perceive an image's visual contents. Requires a vision-capable model; errors clearly otherwise.

commands.name: skill:compact
commands.description: Check context usage and compact the conversation from the Scheme kernel. Use when context is filling up and substantial work remains, so the session is summarized and you keep working instead of stopping early.

commands.name: skill:edit
commands.description: Replace an exact, unique string in an existing file. Use for targeted single-occurrence edits to files from the Scheme kernel instead of rewriting the whole file.

commands.name: skill:goal
commands.description: Manage the persistent thread goal from the Scheme kernel. Use to read goal status and budget usage, to start a goal when the user explicitly asks for one, or to mark the active goal complete once its objective is fully achieved.

commands.name: skill:mcp
commands.description: Use external MCP services generically from the Scheme kernel - search the supported-service catalog, inspect the user's connections, discover live tool schemas, and call tools on any connection (Notion, Linear, Slack, and the rest of the catalog) without per-service packages.

commands.name: skill:prime-intellect
commands.description: Work with Prime Intellect products via the prime CLI and Python SDKs - verifiers environments and the Environments Hub, evaluations (local and hosted), Hosted Training and prime-rl, code sandboxes, Prime Inference, GPU compute (pods and clusters), storage, and tunnels. Use when a task involves Prime Intellect, the prime CLI, verifiers, RL environments, evals, training, sandboxes, renting GPUs, Prime Inference models, or when the user asks what Prime Intellect is or what it offers.

commands.name: skill:refine
commands.description: Trigger continual harness refinement from the Scheme kernel. Use when you notice a repeated failure, reusable tactic, delegation role, or behavior policy that should be persisted as a harness entry. Returns immediately; refinement runs when the current turn ends.

commands.name: skill:rlm-heartbeat
commands.description: Manage agent-owned RLM heartbeats from the Scheme kernel. Use when the user asks the agent to start, create, schedule, or manage a heartbeat, unless they explicitly request the user's /heartbeat.

commands.name: skill:skill-creator
commands.description: Create, validate, and install Prime Agent skills - both markdown skills and skills that add Scheme functions callable from the kernel. Use when the user asks to create a skill, turn a workflow, script, or prompt into a reusable skill, add a function the agent can call, or asks how to write a SKILL.md and where skills live.
